study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Xiao Lin et al., Cerebral Cortex, 2024
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Using normative modeling to assess pharmacological treatment effect on brain state in patients with schizophrenia

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The Cam-CAN (Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience) dataset was used as the reference population to build the normative models. A local dataset from Peking University Sixth Hospital (single-site) was used for the clinical research part, involving schizophrenia patients and a healthy comparison group.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Data used in the preparation of this work were obtained from the Cam-CAN repository ... Forty healthy subjects and 42 patients with schizophrenia were enrolled and gave written informed consent ... at Peking University Sixth Hospital.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Lin2024.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Data set and scanner parameters; Demographic data of the patients with schizophrenia

answer.Cam-CAN: normative training and performance testing via 10-fold cross-validation

answer.SINGLE-SITE: clinical research (schizophrenia patients before and after 6-week antipsychotic treatment) and healthy comparison group

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Cam-CAN was utilized to estimate sex-specific normative age models for dynamic and static functional connectivity features. The local single-site dataset was used to assess individual deviations in patients before and after treatment, and to correlate these with clinical symptoms.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: Based on the large public data set Cam-CAN, we estimated sex-specific normative age models for each dynamic FC feature ... Individualized deviation profiles of 68 features in SCZ patients (including before and after treatment...) were derived from sex-specific normative age models.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Lin2024.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Normative modeling for dynamic FC features; Estimating individual features deviations

model-1.model-name: Dynamic and static FC feature models

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The normative models for 34 functional connectivity features (17 aFCS and 17 fFCS) were built using the Cam-CAN dataset (N=652). A 10-fold cross-validation procedure was used, meaning the entire dataset was involved in the training and evaluation process.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: Data used in the preparation of this work were obtained from the Cam-CAN repository ... (n=652) ... Specifically, the data were randomly divided into 10 folds. Nine-folds were utilized for building the model, whereas the remaining fold was employed to evaluate the general performance of the model.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: Lin2024.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Data set and scanner parameters; Normative modeling for dynamic FC features
